note: Slice m03 (58 baroque composers with one to four recorded IMSLP works). Sources: IMSLP API work pages (scorings, keys, dates), Deezer album and track lists (the /tracks endpoint, because the album endpoint cuts lists at 25 tracks), Apple song search, MusicBrainz works and recordings, and a few pages opened by WebFetch (MusicWeb reviews, The Bach Players). Compilation discs often carry no composer name in their streaming titles (Ravenscroft Op. 1 No. 8, McGibbon, Drese and Clérambault were found only through MusicBrainz and web search), so several 'not performed or recorded' skips are weak; each evidence line says what was searched. Multi-work sets are entered one work per sonata: Pezel's 25 Alphabet Sonatas, Veracini Op. 1 (10), Weichlein Op. 1 (12), Torelli Op. 2 (12), Manfredini Op. 2 (12), Bassani Op. 5 (12), Reincken's 6 Hortus Musicus partitas, Schein's Banchetto musicale (14 of 20 suites, scored for five viols with violins as alternatives; their IMSLP pages were filed as unspecified instruments), Fioré Op. 1 (6 of 12), Nicolai (7 of 12 sonatas and one sonata a 2), Kühnel (5 of 14). Scoring conventions: a violone or cello 'col basso per l'organo' is folded into the continuo, except where the print gives the cello its own part (Fioré; Bassani Op. 5 Nos. 7-12); the viola of Manfredini Op. 2 ('a beneplacito') and the cello of Bassani Op. 5 Nos. 1-6 are optional. String-orchestra questions: Barsanti Op. 4 overtures, Fritz Op. 1 Nos. 5 and 6 (La Stagione Frankfurt, CPO, called Sinfonia), Brant's Sinfonia, and the mandolin concertos of Cecere, Caudioso and Giuliani are skipped. Kept without a confirmed one-to-a-part recording: Pezel's Alphabet Sonatas (Acronym, a 12-member string band), Leo's Concerto for four violins, Fiorenza's recorder concerto, Blavet's flute concerto. Owner decisions: Bassani Op. 1 (second violin 'a beneplacito', recorded complete by Ensemble Armonico Cimento, Tactus) is skipped as a duo; Hotteterre Op. 3, Loeillet Op. 1 and Mouret print flutes first with violins only as an alternative and are skipped as 'no string part' (c10 entered such Boismortier prints with the violins first); Picchi's and Selma y Salaverde's canzonas (1-8 parts, unspecified instruments, recorded complete) are not itemised; Lully's Trios de la Chambre du Roi and Zanetti's Il scolaro are skipped. Levels are estimates from style and the benchmarks, not graded from scores; minutes come from the recordings named in each entry; no benchmarks or violin-catalogue entries in this slice.
